title: Excel contacts → clean data → personalised WhatsApp campaign
text: SheetReach + n8n. The complete workflow, automated end to end.
foot: SHEETREACH · EXCEL → WHATSAPP AUTOMATION WITH n8n

text: Contacts live in Excel. Before a WhatsApp campaign, they must be cleaned, checked for consent and personalised — usually by hand.
Upload a messy contact file. No setup needed.
SheetReach finds the columns, fixes number formats, removes duplicates, and blocks invalid and Do Not Contact numbers.
Only clean, consented contacts are saved.
Write the message once. The first name and company are filled in for every contact.
Now the automation. An n8n workflow takes a new 1,250-row Excel file and runs the whole process through the SheetReach API.
Running live: download the file, clean and validate, check opt-in and Do Not Contact, create the campaign, start sending.
The campaign is running. n8n keeps checking progress until the queue is finished.
Messages go out one by one through the WhatsApp provider. Temporary errors are retried automatically.
Sandbox mode for testing. The official WhatsApp Business Cloud API connects with the client's own Meta account.
Clear results: sent, delivered, failed and skipped — each with a plain reason.
People who reply STOP are added to Do Not Contact and blocked from every future campaign.
The full results are exported to Excel.
n8n finished the run: the execution succeeded, and the final report was built with the Excel results attached.

title: Excel → clean contacts → WhatsApp campaign → report
text: Built on the official WhatsApp Business Cloud API design. Tested on a sandbox provider; the client's Meta account connects for live sending.
